description: This file contains validation functions for the Android Cuttlefish project, including checks for tap devices, host configuration, and kernel information.

methods.name: TestTapDevices
methods.description: Checks if specified tap devices are in use, depending on the sandbox environment.

methods.name: ValidateTapDevices
methods.description: Validates that tap devices are available and not in use.

methods.name: ValidateHostConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the host system configuration, especially on Android.

methods.name: ValidateHostKernel
methods.description: Checks the kernel version and system information.
